props.name: value
props.description: hex color, e.g. `#3b82f6` (or `#3b82f6ff` when `alpha` is on). Controlled: pass `onValueChange` with it.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: starting hex color when the picker manages its own value. Ignored once `value` is passed.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: called with the new hex on every change — the name every other KinetixUI value control uses

props.name: alpha
props.description: show an alpha slider and read/emit 8-digit hex
